reference_hardware: 4-core laptop, cold OS cache, warm index
notes: Rows with applies_to=full-corpus gate full-corpus benchmark runs on reference hardware with a warm index; they are NOT executed on the 14-ayah synthetic fixture (OD-11: no licensed corpus is active yet).
fixture_bound_ms gates the fixture harness and guards against orders-of-magnitude regressions only; it is never a p99 substitute.
No threshold may be silently loosened: any change to a value_ms here must be recorded with a rationale (plan prohibition).

search.normalized_adhoc.p50_ms.rationale: plan 17.1 p50 for search_normalized with ad-hoc rules.

search.normalized_adhoc.p99_ms.rationale: plan 17.1 p99 for search_normalized with ad-hoc rules.

search.phrase.p50_ms.rationale: plan 17.1 p50 for search_phrase (3 tokens, slop 0).

search.phrase.p99_ms.rationale: plan 17.1 p99 for search_phrase (3 tokens, slop 0).

search.concatenated.p99_ms.rationale: ADR-0207 concatenated-search target: p99 <= 150 ms on reference hardware with a warm index.

search.regex.p99_ms.rationale: plan 17.1 p99 for search_regex (anchored); the 3 s hard cap is enforced in the service.

search.root.p50_ms.rationale: plan 17.1 p50 for root_search (frequent root, 339 hits).

search.root.p99_ms.rationale: plan 17.1 p99 for root_search (frequent root, 339 hits).

search.family.p50_ms.rationale: plan 17.1 p50 for word_family (large root, no suggestions).

search.family.p99_ms.rationale: plan 17.1 p99 for word_family (large root, no suggestions).

search.morphology.p50_ms.rationale: plan 17.1 p50 for morphology (single token, all datasets).

search.morphology.p99_ms.rationale: plan 17.1 p99 for morphology (single token, all datasets).

search.frequency.p50_ms.rationale: plan 17.1 p50 for frequency (root, breakdown by surah).

search.frequency.p99_ms.rationale: plan 17.1 p99 for frequency (root, breakdown by surah).

fixture_bound_ms.rationale: Fixture harness bound on the 14-ayah synthetic index: guards against orders-of-magnitude regressions, not p99. Carried over unchanged from the pre-existing search_latency harness (never loosened).

cold_rebuild_total_ms.rationale: P2-T38: cold index rebuild must complete within 6 minutes (360000 ms) end-to-end on reference hardware. OD-11-dependent: requires a licensed corpus to execute.
